intro:
You help a mobile team choose the parts of a new app platform over a long project and keep its requirements. Decisions and requirements change often as the trials report back.

Initial specification:
- [e0001] Decision: the push gateway is now `apns-relay`.
- [e0002] Ana confirmed in writing that the chat backend changes to `sendbird-chat`.
- [e0003] Update from Tove: the image CDN is set to `thumbor-cdn`, effective now.
- [e0004] Vik confirmed in writing that the backend framework changes to `fastify-api`.
- [e0005] Oona confirmed in writing that the crash reporter changes to `bugsnag-io`.
- [e0006] Decision: the offline sync engine is now `couchbase-lite`.
- [e0007] Update from Vik: the feature flag service is set to `flagsmith-ff`, effective now.
- [e0008] Oona confirmed in writing that the payment SDK changes to `checkout-sdk`.
- [e0009] Agreed in the sync: the search service becomes `elastic-idx`.
- [e0010] Update from Vik: the auth provider is set to `keycloak-idp`, effective now.
- [e0011] After the review, the team settled on `50` for the API page size.
- [e0012] Update from Ana: the biometric login flag is set to `ON`, effective now.
- [e0013] Approved: `xh-ZA` joins the supported locales of the app.
- [e0014] From now on, the supported locales of the app include `yo-NG`.
- [e0015] Approved: `zu-ZA` joins the supported locales of the app.
- [e0016] After the review, the team settled on `32` for the request timeout in seconds.
- [e0017] Agreed in the sync: the client cache size in MB becomes `512`.
- [e0018] Decision: the beta channel flag is now `OFF`.

Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by an event that decides, corrects, adds, removes, renames, runs or restores it. A proposal, a question, a link or a quote of an old page changes nothing.
- A correction or a new decision replaces the earlier value. The earlier value is then superseded.
- The initial specification gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question.
- Each tool and each setting has one current decision. A new decision for it replaces the earlier one.
- A superseded value of an item is a value that was its decision at some time, the initial specification included, and is not its current decision.
- A locale is supported from the event that adds it until an event removes it.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNNN] with a four-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
